description: Under the antigravity lens the slash extractor runs over every node body, so `/name` invocations resolve across BOTH kinds via the provider's `invokes: ['skill', 'workflow']` matrix: a workflow's `/run-tests` and `/changelog-entry` resolve to skills, a workflow's `/deploy` resolves to another workflow, and AGENTS.md's `/deploy` (a core/markdown node) resolves to the deploy workflow too. Together with the markdown links to the docs, plus the two resolved self-invocations each skill's body shows as a backticked usage example (`core/backtick-slash`, warn-exempt self-loops), the demo-antigravity corpus yields ten resolved edges and zero issues, proving cross-kind slash resolution end to end.
